newsitem.title: SPAIN: Spain - majority sure they will meet EMU criteria.
newsitem.headline: Spain - majority sure they will meet EMU criteria.

text.p: The Spanish government reiterated on Friday it will meet the European convergence criteria and said the majority of European countries are convinced they will meet the Maastricht's criteria.

"In the European Union the majority of countries are convinced they will meet Maastricht's criteria and also the goal of creating the European single currency," the government spokesman Miguel Angel Rodriguez said at a press conference.
Rodriguez added that Friday's release of April harmonised CPI, which fell to 1.6 percent year-on-year from 2.2 percent in March, provided good evidence that Spain would meet the Maastricht criteria.
Rodriguez said the inflation rate was eight tenths below the minimum level requested in April of 2.4 percent, adding that just one year ago, this would have seemed impossible.
